judgements.reason: OneParameterSemigroups is already in the library end to end -- hilleYosida_generation_iff, exists_contractionSemigroup_generator_eq_iff, hausdorff_bernstein_widder, bochner and bcr_semigroup_bochner are all proved -- leaving only Cauchy-problem uniqueness, complex resolvent analyticity and stretch goals; LieHighestWeight still owes the Weyl character formula endpoint, the centre of U(L) with the Harish-Chandra isomorphism, the Kostant multiplicity formula and the E8/Der(O)=g2 structure theorems.

LieHighestWeight already has Verma modules, the Casimir, Weyl complete reducibility, PBW, Freudenthal and formal characters in TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/HighestWeight, so only the character/Kostant/Harish-Chandra endpoints remain; KTheoryLowDegrees has no K1 at all (no stable GL(A), E(A), Whitehead lemma or SK1), needs Bass-Milnor-Serre, and its comparison layers import the entire plus/Q/Waldhausen tower with spectra and the infinity-categorical core.

Both start from a fair amount (TauCeti's ExactK0 and Mathlib's rankAtStalk for K0; Mathlib's local fields and TauCeti's low-degree Galois cohomology for representations), but KTheoryLowDegrees must additionally import a coherent eight-deep tower -- exact-category K-theory, the plus and Q constructions, Waldhausen, spectra and the infinity-categorical core E0/E5:abstract -- on top of K1, SK1 and Bass-Milnor-Serre, whereas ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations' extra weight is the (also absent) upper-numbering ramification filtration, local Weil groups and abelian schemes, a shallower and smaller body.

DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra is self-contained: depth, Cohen-Macaulay, Auslander-Buchsbaum, Schlessinger, perfect complexes and ultrapatching all sit directly on Mathlib's regular sequences, complete local rings and derived category; ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations needs, in addition to its own conductor and Weil-Deligne theory, three further absent theories -- upper-numbering ramification with Herbrand and Hasse-Arf, local class field theory with the Artin map and Weil group, and abelian schemes with Cartier duality and Weil pairings over algebraic spaces.

DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra is one body of commutative and homological algebra whose classical half (regular sequences, projective dimension, complete local rings, derived categories) Mathlib already supplies; SchemeAndStackFoundations must build algebraic spaces and stacks, proper and smooth base change with compact supports, Serre duality and Picard schemes, formal algebraization, Neron models and alterations, and the whole of Chow groups, Chern classes, Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch and the Hodge index theorem.

SelmerIwasawaCohomology's chain is longer (Poitou-Tate duality, Iwasawa algebras and Lambda-modules, then period rings via perfectoid spaces and the infinity-categorical enhancement, eight roadmaps deep), but SchemeAndStackFoundations has the greater bulk: algebraic spaces and stacks, proper and smooth base change with compact supports and the six-operations integration, Serre duality, Picard schemes and Jacobians, formal algebraization, Neron models and de Jong alterations, and all of Fulton's intersection theory through Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch and Hodge index.

Both must build the infinity-categorical enhancement and derived completion, but CrystallineCohomology's extra is one connected body of p-adic cohomology (PD envelopes, the crystalline site and Poincare lemma, de Rham-Witt, log geometry and Hyodo-Kato), whereas SelmerIwasawaCohomology's extra spans seventeen further roadmaps -- Poitou-Tate global duality, Iwasawa algebras with Lambda-module structure theory, Coleman power series, locally analytic distributions, and period rings resting on perfectoid spaces -- before its own Selmer complexes and control theorems can even be stated.

CrystallineCohomology consumes most of EnhancedDerivedSheaves already (E0-E3 and E5:animation via derived de Rham DD.0/DD.1) and then adds PD envelopes, crystalline sites and crystals, the PD Poincare lemma, finiteness and Frobenius, crystalline duality, the de Rham-Witt complex with Langer-Zink and BLM, log geometry and Hyodo-Kato; what EnhancedDerivedSheaves has beyond that shared core -- E4 derived completion, Ind-completion and animated algebra, and the spectra comparison with StableHomotopyKTheory H.1-H.5 -- is the smaller remainder.

HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions needs seven EnhancedDerivedSheaves stages itself (through crystalline and p-adic Hodge theory on the Faltings route) and then, on top, Br(X) and the Brauer-Manin pairing, Parshin's construction, Faltings and Siegel, Mordell-Lang, Manin-Mumford and Bogomolov with equidistribution, plus Neron models, Arakelov theory, Shimura varieties and PEL moduli.

Both are at the extreme -- SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups' SR.6 drags in the whole Fargues-Scholze apparatus (diamonds, six operations, Bun_G, geometric Satake, parameter stacks and excursion operators) on top of the classical Bernstein/Satake theory -- but HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions' Faltings and Bogomolov branches stack even further, needing Neron models, Arakelov geometry, Shimura data, compactifications and PEL moduli, p-adic Hodge theory with A_inf, and SF.0-SF.5 intersection theory, a chain sixteen stages deep against twelve.

AInfCohomology needs the perfectoid/diamond/Fargues-Fontaine world plus crystalline cohomology, de Rham-Witt, prismatic cohomology and THH; SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups needs that same perfectoid and diamond foundation, and then the six operations on diamonds, Bun_G with its strata, geometric Satake, Langlands parameter stacks, excursion operators, Deligne's weights and WeilConjectures WC.2, before its own Bernstein, Satake and co-Whittaker theory.

The two closures are almost the same size, but WeilConjectures' distinctive imports are heavier: the full etale six-operations and duality package, Deligne's purity and weight theory with Lefschetz pencils, rigid cohomology as a second (p-adic) cohomology theory, and SchemeAndStackFoundations SF.0-SF.5 with Fulton intersection theory and Hodge index -- against AInfCohomology's perfectoid, diamond, Fargues-Fontaine, prismatic and crystalline stack; WeilConjectures also stacks four levels deeper.

The two share the classical etale-cohomology apparatus, but beyond it WeilConjectures adds Deligne's purity, rigid cohomology and Fulton intersection theory, whereas BunGAndNewtonStrata adds the entire perfectoid, diamond and v-stack world, the relative Fargues-Fontaine curve with its vector-bundle classification and Banach-Colmez spaces, etale cohomology and the six operations for diamonds, geometric Satake and then Bun_G itself -- roughly twice as much unshared theory.

BunGAndNewtonStrata already needs the enhancement that EnhancedDerivedSheaves builds, and then perfectoid spaces, diamonds and v-stacks, the relative Fargues-Fontaine curve and its vector bundles, etale cohomology and the six operations for diamonds, the Kottwitz and Newton invariants, and the smooth-Artin theorem for Bun_G with its strata and charts.

HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions contains almost all of WeilConjectures' foundation (SchemeAndStackFoundations, the etale duality package and Lefschetz pencils are shared) and then adds Neron models, Arakelov geometry, Shimura varieties and PEL moduli, p-adic Hodge theory with crystalline and A_inf cohomology, perfectoid spaces and diamonds, plus Faltings, Siegel, Mordell-Lang and Bogomolov; WeilConjectures' unshared remainder is only Deligne's purity, rigid cohomology and its own zeta assembly.

KTheoryLowDegrees needs one tower -- classical K0/K1 plus the higher K-theory constructions, spectra and the infinity-categorical core; SelmerIwasawaCohomology needs that same infinity-categorical core (E0-E3, E5) through derived completion and, on top of it, general-degree continuous cohomology, Poitou-Tate global duality, Iwasawa algebras with Lambda-module structure theory, Coleman power series, locally analytic distributions and period rings built on perfectoid spaces.

AInfCohomology consumes CrystallineCohomology almost whole (CR.0, CR.2, CR.4, CR.5 and CR.6 are prerequisites of AI.0, AI.4 and AI.6) while CrystallineCohomology only borrows the decalage functor AI.1 back, and AInfCohomology then adds perfectoid spaces and quotients, the pro-etale period sheaves, diamonds, the relative Fargues-Fontaine curve, prismatic cohomology and THH before its own AOmega and BKF theory.

LieHighestWeight is largely built in TauCeti/Algebra/Lie (Verma modules, Casimir and central characters, Weyl complete reducibility, PBW, Freudenthal, octonions and E6/E7/F4/G2), with only the character-formula endpoint, Harish-Chandra and E8 outstanding; ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations has nothing of its own in place and needs upper-numbering ramification with Hasse-Arf, local class field theory with the Weil group, Artin and Swan conductors, Chenevier determinants and abelian-scheme Tate modules.

SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups' SR.6 consumes BunGAndNewtonStrata essentially entirely (BG2:smooth-Artin, BG3 and BG4 through VS4 and ES7:parabolic) and then adds Langlands parameter stacks, excursion operators, geometric Satake, Hecke stacks, Deligne's weights and WeilConjectures WC.2, plus the whole classical layer -- Hecke algebras, Jacquet functors, second adjointness, the Bernstein centre, Satake and co-Whittaker modules.

DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra needs no other roadmap and builds depth, Cohen-Macaulay theory, Schlessinger, perfect complexes and patching on Mathlib's existing local-ring and derived-category API; CrystallineCohomology must first import the infinity-categorical enhancement and derived de Rham and then build PD envelopes, the crystalline site, the PD Poincare lemma, crystalline duality, the de Rham-Witt complex, log geometry and Hyodo-Kato.

KTheoryLowDegrees' missing theory is substantial but concentrated -- K1, SK1 and Bass-Milnor-Serre plus the higher K-theory tower of spectra, plus/Q/Waldhausen constructions and the infinity-categorical core -- while SchemeAndStackFoundations must build several independent bodies: algebraic spaces and stacks, proper and smooth base change with compact supports, Serre duality and Picard schemes/Jacobians, formal algebraization with Neron models and alterations, and all of Chow groups, Chern classes, Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch and Hodge index.

WeilConjectures needs six EnhancedDerivedSheaves stages for its coefficient formalism and then the whole etale six-operations and duality package, Deligne's purity with Lefschetz pencils, rigid cohomology, SchemeAndStackFoundations with Fulton intersection theory, and finally its own rationality, functional-equation and Riemann-hypothesis assembly.

HeightsRationalPointsAndObstructions already needs three SelmerIwasawaCohomology stages together with the same p-adic Hodge and Iwasawa-measure imports, and adds on top Brauer-Manin obstruction theory, Parshin and Faltings with Neron models, Arakelov geometry and Shimura/PEL moduli, and Mordell-Lang, Manin-Mumford and Bogomolov.

LieHighestWeight's engine is already in the library (sl2 theory, root systems, Verma modules, the Casimir, Weyl complete reducibility, PBW and Freudenthal), leaving named endpoints; DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra has six of its nine layers unbuilt, needing depth and Cohen-Macaulay theory, Auslander-Buchsbaum, Schlessinger's criterion and hulls, perfect complexes with derived completion, patching and ultrapatching, and the Calegari-Geraghty support theorems.
